operations.details: Verified EA Vegetation Object Model record.
Derived canopy-height model separated from bare-earth terrain.
Potential classification errors retained as explicit limitation.
Canopy height above ground rejected as parcel ground elevation.
Verified current OS Net/OSTN15/OSGM15 accuracy page.
OS Net station coordinate errors separated from parcel observation errors.
OSGM15 0.008m GB height standard error preserved without omitting GNSS errors.
Transformation, GNSS, raster, geometry and sampling errors kept as separate budget components.
EA VOM and OS Net accuracy URLs confirmed absent from prior registry.
No canopy model or transformation-only uncertainty substituted for terrain measurement.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
